message: I remember the time my phone died right in the middle of a blackout while I was trying to navigate a power outage. I had the flashlights ready, but without my trusty power bank, I was left in the dark—literally! Now, I always keep my phone charged up and handy, along with a power bank in the emergency kit. It's a little thing that makes a big difference when the lights go out! What’s your go-to tip for staying powered up during outages? 😊
